title: 热点的账单：用六个核心，诊断过去一年的热搜与争论 / The Bill of the Hot List: Six Lenses on a Year of Hot Debates
description:
中文. 本著作是系列的方法演示：用六个核心，把过去一年被反复讨论的公共事件做成一张张诊断卡。

核心主张：看懂一个热点，不是站对一边，而是看清它让出了什么。六把尺子（看见、记住、跟上、选择、讲述、临界）不问“谁对”，只问“卡在哪一层”。

结构与证据：18 章、106 页、8 幅图；68 张诊断卡（26 张数据主卡 + 3 张补卡 + 34 张主题卡 + 5 张长卡），另加 30 条一句话诊断全部来自真实公开存档（338 天、2875 个话题；X 趋势 81 个“国家—日”采样），另设季度复盘、方法自检、十个反例与 90 分钟工作坊。

诚实的纪律：每张卡标证据等级与可反驳条件；数据缺口与口径问题逐条写明；明确诊断的是讨论的结构，不是事件的对错。

边界：案例会过期，方法不会；它不预测、不判决，也不替代一手来源。

版本：2026-10-18，106 页，18 章，8 图，68 张卡；采集与统计脚本开源，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

本版更新（2026-10-18 地基版）。本版把全书的共同前提写到卷首：现实中不存在无限——无限只作为极限出现在模型里，从不出现在现实系统的实际状态里。有限性本身只说明“有上界”；它要变成“必须让出一样”，还需要三个条件同时成立：需求随规模增长、描述/组合/传递共享同一承载者、同时维持两种活动更贵（交互惩罚 ψ>0）。因此“至多取二”一律是“紧预算（K/D 有界）下至多取二”的简写；若预算增长快于需求，三项可以同时满格。

本版新增内容。第 3 章新增 3.27 补卡说明与 3.28–3.30 三张结构补卡：社保新规、骗婚、司法公信（不接入 338 天存档计数，B/C，不对具体案件作事实裁定）；全书 68 张诊断卡均新增“本卡假设的无限”字段；修正“十二个真实热点”为“二十六个”、“四张长卡”为“五张”。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/hotspot-bills。首选预览文件：hotspot-bills-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This is the series' methodological demonstration: six cores turn a year of contested public events into diagnostic cards. Core thesis: understanding a hot topic is not about taking the right side but about seeing what it gives up; six lenses ask not “who is right” but “on which layer is the argument stuck”. Structure and evidence: 18 chapters, 106 pages, 8 figures; 68 diagnostic cards (26 data cards + 3 supplementary cards + 34 thematic cards + 5 long-form), plus 30 one-line diagnoses drawn from real public archives — 338 days and 2,875 topics from Zhihu, plus 81 country–day samples of X trends — together with a quarterly review, a method self-audit, ten counterexamples and a 90-minute workshop. Discipline: every card carries an evidence grade and a refutation condition; data gaps and measurement caveats are stated; the object of diagnosis is the structure of the argument, not the facts of the case. Boundaries: cases expire, the method does not; it neither predicts nor judges, and never replaces primary sources. Edition: 2026-10-18, 106 pages, 18 chapters, 8 figures, 68 cards.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-18, Finitude Edition). The common premise is now stated at the front: there is no infinity in reality — infinity appears only as a limit in models, never as a property of a real system. Finitude alone only says that there is a ceiling; to yield a trade-off it also needs three conditions: demand grows with scale, description/composition/transfer share one bearer, and maintaining two activities at once is more expensive (interaction penalty ψ>0). “At most two” is therefore shorthand for “at most two under a tight budget (bounded K/D)”; if the budget grows faster than demand, all three can be full.

New in this edition. Chapter 3 adds §3.27 and three supplementary cards (§3.28–3.30): social-insurance rules, marriage fraud, and judicial credibility (not counted in the 338-day archive; B/C; no factual adjudication of specific cases). All 68 cards now carry a “what infinity does this card assume?” field; the counts “twelve hot topics” and “four long cards” are corrected to “twenty-six” and “five”.
notes: 科目（中文）：科学普及 Popular Science、复杂系统 Complex Systems、媒介研究 Media Studies、科学方法论 Scientific Methodology、社会观察 Social Commentary。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：18 章，约 100 页。首选预览文件：hotspot-bills-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
